exact_release_proof.script:
import json,hashlib
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.induction_v3.continuation import select_condition
from experiments.induction_v3.diagnostic import remaining_limits
root=Path('.');path=root/'release/induction-v3/continuation.json'
release=json.loads(path.read_text());plain=dict(release);expected=plain.pop('release_hash')
canonical=lambda v:json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()
assert expected=='e7b5052a3cb9e1b00cda86e6dc31585a2fa48f6a97dfd6c3bb09b266b8c0c8c2'
assert hashlib.sha256(canonical(plain)).hexdigest()==expected
for name,digest in release['source_inventory'].items():
    p=root/name
    assert not p.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
original=json.loads((root/'release/induction-v3/campaign.json').read_text())
for key in ('recipes','schedules','scoring','sandbox_image'):
    assert release[key]==original[key],key
assert release['original_release_hash']==original['release_hash']
diag_release=json.loads((root/'release/induction-v3/diagnostic-final.json').read_text())
assert release['diagnostic_release_hash']==diag_release['release_hash']
diag_dir=root/release['diagnostic_run']
diag=json.loads((diag_dir/'diagnostic_result.json').read_text())
assert diag['status']=='completed' and diag['completed']==12 and not diag['unrun']
assert len(diag['rows'])==12
byhash={c['request_hash']:c for c in diag_release['cells']}
byid={r['cell_id']:r for r in diag['rows']}
responses=list((diag_dir/'responses').glob('*.json'))
assert len(responses)==12
for p in responses:
    wrapper=json.loads(p.read_text());body=wrapper['body'];cell=byhash[wrapper['request_hash']];row=byid[cell['cell_id']]
    assert body['status']=='completed' and body['model']=='gpt-5.6-luna'
    calls=[x for x in body['output'] if x['type']=='function_call']
    assert len(calls)==1 and calls[0]['name']=='submit_verdict'
    verdict=json.loads(calls[0]['arguments'])
    assert verdict['verdict']==cell['expected']==row['actual']
    assert isinstance(verdict['reasoning'],str) and verdict['reasoning']==row['visible_explanation']
assert select_condition(diag)==release['capability_condition']=='original'
assert release['context_treatment'] is None and release['repair_allowed'] is False
assert all(diag['conditions'][name]['passed'] and diag['conditions'][name]['correct']==6 for name in ('original','schema_clarified'))
assert release['limits']==remaining_limits(release['prior_v3'],diagnostic=False)
assert Decimal(release['limits']['campaign_limit_usd'])+Decimal(release['prior_v3']['cost_usd'])==Decimal('100')
assert release['limits']['max_attempts']+release['prior_v3']['physical_attempts']==4000
failed=json.loads((root/original['run_directory']/'capability_result.json').read_text())
assert failed['passed'] is False and failed['completed']==1
assert not (root/release['run_directory']).exists()
files=['experiments/induction_v3/continuation.py','tests/induction_v3/test_continuation.py','tests/induction_v3/test_continuation_science.py','reports/induction-v3/execution/CONTINUATION_DECISION.md']
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','release_hash':expected,'release_file_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'run_id':release['run_id'],'hash_bound_files':len(release['source_inventory']),'condition':'original','diagnostic_responses_independently_reconstructed':12,'original_gate_remains_failed':True,'recipes_schedules_scoring_unchanged':True,'remaining_campaign_usd':release['limits']['campaign_limit_usd'],'remaining_attempts':release['limits']['max_attempts'],'provider_calls_by_auditor':0,'run_directory_absent':True,'files':[{'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for name in files]},sort_keys=True))
